sources.title: GitHub - dcbothra/lunarlander_dqn: Lunar Lander v3 implementation using DQN
sources.snippet: This project implements a Deep Q-Network (DQN) to train an agent in the LunarLander-v3 environment from Gymnasium. The goal is to achieve a reward threshold greater than 200 using reward shaping and exploration strategies. Training is optimized to complete in under 2 hours on standard CPU/GPU setups.
